vjimc-2010-cat2-01.prompt:
Let $a$ and $b$ be given positive coprime integers. Then for every integer $n$ there exist integers $x,y$ such that
$$n=ax+by .$$
Prove that $n=ab$ is the greatest integer for which $xy\le0$ in all such representations of $n$.
vjimc-2010-cat2-01.answer: For $n=ab$: $a\mid y$, $b\mid x$, so $x>0$ forces $x\ge b$ and $y\le0$. For $n>ab$: the representation with $1\le x\le b$ has $by=n-ax\ge n-ab>0$.

vjimc-2010-cat2-02.prompt: Prove or disprove that if a real sequence $(a_n)$ satisfies $a_{n+1}-a_n\to0$ and $a_{2n}-2a_n\to0$ as $n\to\infty$, then $a_n\to0$.

vjimc-2010-cat2-03.prompt:
Let $A$ and $B$ be two $n\times n$ matrices with integer entries such that all of the matrices
$$A,\quad A+B,\quad A+2B,\quad A+3B,\quad\dots,\quad A+(2n)B$$
are invertible and their inverses have integer entries, too. Show that $A+(2n+1)B$ is also invertible and that its inverse has integer entries.
vjimc-2010-cat2-03.answer: $P(t)=\det(A+tB)$ is a polynomial of degree $\le n$ taking values $\pm1$ at the $2n+1$ points $0,\dots,2n$; one value is taken $n+1$ times, so $P$ is constant $\pm1$; then the adjugate formula gives an integer inverse.

vjimc-2010-cat2-04.prompt:
Let $f:[0,1]\to\mathbb R$ be a function satisfying
$$|f(x)-f(y)|\le|x-y|$$
for every $x,y\in[0,1]$. Show that for every $\varepsilon>0$ there exists a countable family of rectangles $(R_i)$ of dimensions $a_i\times b_i$, $a_i\le b_i$, in the plane such that
$$\{(x,f(x)) : x\in[0,1]\}\subset\bigcup_iR_i\qquad\text{and}\qquad\sum_ia_i<\varepsilon .$$
(The edges of the rectangles are not necessarily parallel to the coordinate axes.)
vjimc-2010-cat2-04.answer: Call $[x,y]$ *$\eta$-flat* if the graph over it stays within $\eta(y-x)$ of the chord; any non-flat interval contains a subinterval of proportional length whose slope is larger by $\eta$, so after at most $1/\eta$ steps one finds a flat subinterval of length $\ge c|I|$. Exhaust $[0,1]$ by flat intervals (thin rectangles along chords, total width $\le2\eta$) up to a remainder of small length (covered by small squares).
